decisions.rationale: Names one specific form of disease (autosomal recessive familial neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus) with a single definition. The whole phrase is kept as the minimum necessary span for the most specific form, and 'autosomal recessive' is part of the disease name rather than a separate class.

decisions.rationale: Refers to the specific disease familial neurohypophyseal diabetes insipidus, defined by a single description and not further subdivided in this mention.

Describes a family of diseases that are inherited in a particular genetic pattern (autosomal dominant), so it is a grouping rather than one specific disease. This matches the guideline example 'autosomal recessive disease' as a Disease Class.

Refers to a particular named condition, arginine vasopressin deficiency, which is the pathological state causing the diabetes insipidus. It is a specific, identifiable condition like 'C7 deficiency', so it is not excluded as a general use of 'deficiency'.
